claims.text: Here \(a=b=2\), and the accepted generating families are \[ \{s_{22},s_{32},s_{42},s_{33},s_{43},s_{44}\},\qquad \{s_{22},s_{221},s_{222},s_{2211},s_{2221},s_{2222}\}. \] Each has six elements and generates \(J\). Its image therefore surjects \(\mathbb Z^6\twoheadrightarrow J/A_+J\cong\mathbb Z^6\). By the accepted indexed-family Nakayama criterion, each image is a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis; thus no proper subfamily generates \(J\).
The requested \(c=4\) minimality corollary is established: both displayed six-element families are minimal generating sets of \(J\).
